title: API takes 4s to respond with 200+ students matching
text:
## Problem

When more than 200 students run matching at the same time, `POST /match` sometimes takes around **4 seconds** to respond. For the Nov 2 beta launch it needs to be **under 1 second**.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Load the Westbrook University sample data on staging
2. Run the load test: `npm run loadtest -- --students 250`
3. Check the p95 response time in the report

## Notes

- Most of the time is spent comparing every student's free-time grid with every other student's.
- Idea: group students by course first, then only compare free time inside each course.

Reported by Daniel Ortiz. Blocking the beta launch.
